This
 document out lists the inspection I3 , to be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The first draft initiated by eng Gamal Sayed 
 Soliman tested at 17 Sep 02, at Assuit 500 ME,

items: A work order must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Air compressor must be isolated and the main air tank must be isolated.
Complete tool set
Check the values of pressure gauges.
Drain the main air tank.

Check the frequancy of the automatic operation of the air compressor unit 
 by checking the air leakage.
Check the oil level of the compressor.
Check the indication of compressor's first stage pressure gauge.
Calibbration of the pressure gauge.
Check the performance of pressure switchs and safety valves.
Draining of pipe line.
Check the pressure reducing device and safety valves
Check the control panel.
Check the air leakage and the air compressor unit.

Introduction
This
 document out lists the inspection I3 , to be performed

The first draft initiated by eng Gamal Sayed 
 Soliman tested at 17 Sep 02, at Assuit 500 ME,
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Air compressor must be isolated and the main air tank must be isolated.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set

Drain the main air tank.
